Common questions

Before a first conversation.

Clear answers for care-centre directors, coordinators, residents, and families considering dental care at the centre.

On this pageThe servicePlanning a visitResidents and care

01 / The service

What Global Smile Care provides

Who is the service for?+

The mobile service is intended for residents of residential care centres who benefit from receiving dental attention in a familiar setting.

What care can be provided at the centre?+

The team provides examinations and suitable straightforward dental treatment. The precise scope is discussed with the centre before visits begin.

Is this part of a dental practice?+

Yes. The mobile service is provided by Global Smile Care, which also operates a dental practice at Tolstraat 40 in Antwerp-Zuid.

02 / Planning a visit

How visits are organised

How does a care centre get started?+

Start with an introductory conversation. The centre and Global Smile Care can discuss residents, practical requirements, timing, and the best way to coordinate a first visit.

Who coordinates residents on the day?+

The dental team works with a designated person at the centre. Together they agree how residents are prepared and how the visit fits the centre’s daily routines.

How long does a visit take?+

Timing depends on the number of residents and the agreed care. The schedule is prepared with the centre rather than using a fixed visit length.

03 / Residents and care

A calm, suitable approach

Can families ask questions?+

Yes. The centre can include the appropriate family member or representative in communication according to its usual consent and care procedures.

What information should we send through the website?+

For the first enquiry, only send your professional contact details and general information about the centre. Do not include resident medical or dental information in the website form.

What if a resident needs care beyond the mobile service?+

The dental team can explain what is suitable within the care-centre setting and discuss the appropriate next step when other treatment is needed.

Still considering the details?

Ask the team directly.

Every centre works differently. A short introduction is the best place to discuss your residents and practical setup.
